items.author: Stephen Pimentel
items.text:
It used to be a common belief that raising a family was an act of great service to the larger community, worthy of a life’s work, without any regard for “changing the world.”

That this is no longer a common belief accounts for many of the ways in which our society is screwed up.

items.author: Mimi Morgan
items.text:
So many people in the comments saying, I have arthritis I can't.

It's a low bar for over 60. 

Yes you can, clean up your diet, loose excess weight, build muscle slowly, move everyday

Torn meniscus, 2 rotator cuff tears, severe osteoarthritis, L2-4 Discitis/Osteomylitis, damaged psoas. 

I started with a walker, then 10 steps and kept going. If I can do it, you can. The only thing special about me is...I didn't quit.

items.author: Preethi Kasireddy
items.text:
Brain fog postpartum is no joke. Especially those first 6-8 weeks.

Personally, I take creatine for brain fog and focus, along with Alpha-GPC. Works like a charm.

A lot of people think creatine is just for guys at the gym. I think every mom should be taking it.

Most moms are not eating nearly enough meat and fish to get enough of it through diet.

items.author: Metabolic Mind
items.text:

A recent review co-authored by @ChrisPalmerMD finds encouraging evidence, particularly for depressive symptoms when used alongside other care. 🧵

items.author: Santa Carota Beef
items.text:
The rain has been good to us, but we sure wouldn’t mind a little more! Thankfully, there’s more rain in the forecast, along with a little sunshine in between. The cattle are happy, the green grass is growing, and we’re looking forward to seeing even more of it in the coming weeks.

We’re grateful for every drop of rain and the good it brings to the land. Almost Friday! Wishing everyone a great rest of the week and sending blessings your way from the ranch. 🧡

items.author: Tao Lin
items.text:
In second or third or fourth grade, a man named Tao Lin came in to speak to our class. I'd never met or heard of another Tao Lin. I felt embarrassed. 

Today, I see there are hundreds, maybe thousands, of Tao Lins, and I no longer feel embarrassed by the existence of other Tao Lins.
